title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
slides: Your model's secrets may already be exposed.
Attackers copied an OpenAI employee's drive.
The breach bypassed all safety guardrails.
Your own AI now trusts untested third-party code.
Audit every dependency before deploying any model.
thread_text:
1. Your model's naked now.

Attackers copied an OpenAI employee's drive — and your safety guardrails were built on that same trust.

2. The breach bypassed everything.

Not just a leak — the stolen data let them impersonate the model itself. No alert fired.

3. AI trusts what you don't check.

Your deployed model accepted untested third-party code. One stolen credential was enough to fool it.

4. Your dependencies are the backdoor.

That open-source library you imported yesterday? It can now whisper commands into your model's outputs.

5. Audit every dependency before deploy.

Pull your latest model's dependency list right now. Do you know who wrote each line?
